title: Final Review and Assessment

# PV101 Day 8 Daily Run Sheet

Instructor-facing plan for Rich or a substitute | Thursday, July 16, 2026

Day_08_PV101_Final_Review_and_Assessment_2026-07-16

Topic: Final Review and Assessment

Class setup: 6 students | 10:00 AM-3:00 PM | Calm, practical, evidence-first instruction

# Teaching frame

Main message: the final checks whether students can apply PV101 fundamentals safely and clearly.

The final is a traditional graded assessment: 25 questions, one point each.

Do not coach answers during the final. Clarify directions or unreadable wording only.

PV101 ends today with reflection, evidence collection, and a clean instructional closeout—no capstone or certification exercise.

# Substitute quick start

[ ] Read the full schedule before students arrive.

[ ] Locate emergency disconnects, first-aid supplies, calculator policy, and secure test storage.

[ ] Print student materials and keep answer keys/instructor notes separate.

[ ] Write the day goal, schedule, and stop-work rule on the board.

[ ] If uncertain about equipment or assessment handling, use the reduced-scope path and contact program leadership.

# Learning targets

Recall and apply core ideas from all 12 assigned chapters.

Use formulas, diagrams, sequencing, and written reasoning accurately.

Choose safe verification and troubleshooting steps instead of guessing.

Complete a traditional graded 25-question assessment independently.

Reflect on PV101 growth and leave materials organized and secure.

# Materials

Readiness quiz and key

Day 8 slide deck and whiteboard outline

25-question final tests and secured answer key

Calculators and scratch paper as allowed

Reflection sheet and evidence checklist

Folders/envelopes for completed graded work

# Daily schedule

| Time | Block | Instructor notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10:00-10:10 | Arrival, attendance, check-in | Students receive readiness quiz only. Final tests remain secured. |
| 10:10-10:20 | Day goal + test expectations | Explain the day: review, demonstrate individual understanding, reflect, and close PV101. |
| 10:20-10:35 | Morning readiness quiz | Short five-question check distinct from the graded final. |
| 10:35-10:55 | Readiness review | Correct together. Use results to choose which misconceptions need the most review. |
| 10:55-11:20 | Whiteboard review | Sort concepts into energy path, measurement, workmanship, protection, troubleshooting, and sizing. |
| 11:20-11:30 | Break | Students reset. Instructor keeps final tests and answer key controlled. |
| 11:30-12:00 | Slides: cumulative review | Review formulas, meter discipline, protection, series/parallel, troubleshooting evidence, and sizing steps. |
| 12:00-12:20 | Practice questions | Work examples that are similar in skill but not identical to final-test questions. |
| 12:20-12:30 | Final instructions | Explain 25 questions, one point each, calculator policy, quiet conditions, and how to request clarification. |
| 12:30-1:00 | Lunch | Final tests remain secured. No discussion of test content. |
| 1:00-2:10 | PV101 final assessment | Traditional graded 25-question cumulative test. Instructor monitors without coaching answers. |
| 2:10-2:20 | Collect + verify materials | Count every test and scratch page. Store answer key separately. |
| 2:20-2:35 | Course reflection | Students reflect on verification, growth, remaining practice needs, and safe-work habits. |
| 2:35-2:45 | PV101 closeout discussion | Name the skills completed and state simply that PV101 is complete. No capstone or project presentation. |
| 2:45-2:55 | Evidence + Classroom upload | Submit reflection and any required learning evidence; instructor completes evidence checklist. |
| 2:55-3:00 | Cleanup + dismissal | Room reset, materials counted, student papers secured, PV101 formally closed. |

# Safety and instructional stop conditions

Final tests or answer keys are unaccounted for.

Students discuss answers during the individual test.

A question appears to require content not taught; note it for review without coaching an answer.

A student becomes overwhelmed; provide a quiet reset while preserving test integrity.

Assessment materials are photographed or uploaded without authorization.

# Reduced-scope backup

Day 7: if calculators or printing fail, complete one class example on the whiteboard and have students show units and reasonableness on notebook paper. Day 8: if final-test printing fails, run structured review and reflection; do not improvise a different final from memory. Reschedule the secured assessment.

# Early finishers

Day 7: check every unit, redo one calculation independently, and write one sentence explaining each sizing result. Day 8: quietly review answers, then begin the reflection only after turning in the final.
